title: Obligation
description: One required change derived from a provider change and the evidence for it. FROZEN (ARCHITECTURE.md 5). Built by the Obligation Engine in Phase 6; no Phase 1 code path writes one.

provider_change_id.description: Identifier of the Change Pack entry this obligation discharges.

current_state.description: What is there now, at file:line.

required_state.description: What must be there for the target version. An agent receives this, never 'upgrade the repo'.

repair_class.description: Who may perform the repair. PRESERVE_UNKNOWN carries an UNKNOWN forward rather than forcing it closed.

verification_method.description: The check that proves this obligation was discharged, named before the repair is attempted.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Left as a pattern rather than an enum because the Phase 6 repair loop defines the members.
